description: SAMPLE layout for the demo, drawn over the Jülich bottleneck experiment (not a real venue): an entry corridor 5.6 m wide narrows to one gate into the hall. Side door B (2 m wide, normally closed) also leads into the hall, and the outer queue can be held at the barrier before the corridor.

places.name: Outer queue barrier
places.note: stewards can stop the inflow here

places.name: Main gate
places.note: narrow, one person at a time

places.name: Side door B
places.note: 2 m wide, closed now; gate staff can open it
